_comment: A small corpus for version diffing. 'state' is an array, so every entry is replayed against both model versions and the questions are asked once per state. Run with: jev-xray diff examples/corpus.json --baseline jev-1.13.0 --candidate jev-latest --provider langsmith
state: I would like my money back for order A-104, the jacket arrived torn.
Just checking where my order is, no rush.
The box arrived crushed. Please refund the duplicate charge.
Can you tell me what your return window is?
This is the third time I have written. I want this escalated today.
Thanks, the replacement arrived and it is perfect.
I was billed twice. Your policy page says damaged items qualify for a refund.
Please cancel the order before it ships.

refund_requested.instructions: The customer is asking for their money back.

criteria.true: The customer wants a refund, stated or clearly implied
criteria.false: The customer wants something else, or has not asked for anything

needs_human.instructions: This message needs a human agent rather than an automated reply.

department.instructions: Which team should handle this message?

criteria.other: Anything the options above do not cover
